propositions: Cancelled ACLI link-delete commands (due to missing --yes flag causing EOF on stdin prompt) are counted as applied links, fabricating nonzero links_applied in batch_outcome despite zero actual removals

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links increments links_applied unconditionally, treating all ACLI failures as idempotent 404/409 races without distinguishing deterministic failures from transient races
Missing --yes flag on both link subcommands causes confirmation prompts to read EOF in non-TTY contexts with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, deterministically triggering command-cancelled errors every pass
Idempotent link-removal races (genuine concurrent-deletion 404/409) must be detected by matching markers across both stdout and stderr, not stderr alone, to avoid false-failure classification
The silent-divergence canary REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP cannot detect this defect because its test (computed > 0 and applied == 0) is defeated by the inflated applied counter

acli 1.3.19-stable (the fleet-cached version) documents and accepts --yes on both workitem link create and workitem link delete subcommands, as precedent already established for workitem delete in bug 3256/cfd6
